title: Law to phase out horse-drawn carriages by 2028
summary: This bill would ban new licenses for horse-drawn cab horses and prohibit their operation starting June 1, 2028, while requiring humane treatment when carriage horses are sold or transferred. It also directs the city to run a workforce program helping carriage drivers and workers move into other jobs. The bill follows recent carriage horse deaths and a fatal 2026 accident in Central Park.
